description: This file defines the StsClient class for interacting with AWS Security Token Service (STS). It includes methods for assuming roles, obtaining credentials, and managing regional endpoints. The class extends AwsClient and adds specific functionality for STS.

classes.name: StsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Security Token Service, providing methods for token management and credential creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StsClient with configuration options, including regional endpoint settings.

methods.name: createCredentials
methods.description: Creates Aws\Credentials\Credentials from the result of STS operations, extracting relevant data and handling errors.

methods.name: addBuiltIns
methods.description: Adds service-specific built-in configurations related to regional endpoint settings.
